answer: Treat every outbound delivery as a voyage needing stamped papers. The courier posts a 50-token bond per route, two endorsers staking 25 each behind it. A 1,000-fake farm locks 50,000 tokens and bleeds 150 a day, near $12,000 monthly, while an honest courier pays one refundable 50-token deposit. No summit outvotes the ledger when bonds pay watchers first. A sybil fleet is a paper navy: grand on the map, sunk at the first stamp.
